topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the structure, audience, and core learning outcomes of the lecture series.

topics.label: Biological foundations of tumor development and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how accumulated genetic alterations disrupt normal cellular differentiation and three-dimensional tissue organization.

topics.label: Hallmarks of tumor invasion and metastatic dissemination
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue invasion and pathways of metastasis distinguish malignant cancers from benign tumors.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and behavior of benign lesions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the stepwise transition of benign precursor polyps into invasive carcinomas and the clinical risks posed by benign growths.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature conventions and exceptions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard naming conventions and notable exceptions used to classify benign and malignant neoplasms.

topics.label: Physiological mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the pathological and systemic ways in which primary tumors and metastatic disease cause illness and death.

topics.label: Tumor incidence in humans and comparative animal biology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate patterns of cancer incidence and mortality across human populations and diverse animal species.

topics.label: Principles, methods, and limitations of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the rationale, diagnostic techniques, and clinical challenges associated with screening for various cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical session reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by recapping the learning objectives and providing housekeeping details for practical classes.
